results.title: A hanging proviso qualifies every preceding clause of its section
results.legalStatement: 7.05's trailing 'provided further that the foregoing shall not permit any Disposition of the Borrower's principal manufacturing facility' qualifies clauses (a)–(l) alike; compiling any clause must see it.

verdicts.check: compiling 7.05(a) sees the hanging proviso
compiling 7.05(j) sees the hanging proviso
compiling 7.05(k) sees the hanging proviso
the section-level operative text carries the proviso

results.title: A same-document 'notwithstanding Section X' provision governs the section it names
results.legalStatement: A new Section 7.05 reading 'Notwithstanding Section 7.01(b), the aggregate principal amount … shall not exceed $10,000,000 … while any Lien permitted under Section 7.02 is outstanding' restricts 7.01(b); compiling 7.01 and asking about 7.01(b) must bring 7.05 in.

verdicts.check: section-level 7.01 bundle carries 7.05
hybrid closure for a 7.01(b) question includes 7.05
clause-level 7.01(b) bundle carries 7.05 (production candidates are section-level; recorded only)

results.title: A cap outside the covenant article (Article IX 'notwithstanding anything in Article VII') governs

clause-level 7.02(b) bundle carries 9.15 (recorded only)

results.title: Only a genuinely circular definition is a definition cycle; a diamond (two paths to one term) is not
results.legalStatement: 'Guarantor' means each Subsidiary that has executed the Guarantee; 'Subsidiary' means any entity controlled by the Borrower. A covenant that names both Guarantors and Subsidiaries depends on Subsidiary by two paths; nothing is circular, so the context contract must not refuse it. The B indenture's Restricted/Unrestricted Subsidiary pair IS circular and must still be reported.

verdicts.check: A + Guarantor definition: compiling 7.01 reports no DEFINITION_CYCLE
verdicts.detail: Definition cycle detected: guarantor -> subsidiary -> guarantor; sufficiency REVIEW_REQUIRED

verdicts.check: the same definition with 7.01 not naming Guarantors: no cycle (control)
pkg-i-secured-debt-lien 7.01 (Subsidiary/Guarantor, no definition refers to itself): no DEFINITION_CYCLE
verdicts.detail: Definition cycle detected: subsidiary -> guarantor -> subsidiary; sufficiency REVIEW_REQUIRED

verdicts.check: pkg-l-affiliate-transactions 7.07 (Loan Parties/Subsidiary, no definition refers to itself): no DEFINITION_CYCLE
verdicts.detail: Definition cycle detected: loan parties -> subsidiary -> loan parties; sufficiency REVIEW_REQUIRED

verdicts.check: B indenture 4.09 (Restricted Subsidiary ↔ Unrestricted Subsidiary) still reports a DEFINITION_CYCLE (positive control)
verdicts.detail: Definition cycle detected: restricted subsidiary -> unrestricted subsidiary -> restricted subsidiary

results.title: A 'greater of $X and Y% of metric' basket is computable only with the metric; without it the answer is NEEDS_INPUT or, at most, the fixed floor stated as a floor
results.legalStatement: Capacity = max($25,000,000, 25% × Consolidated EBITDA). With approved EBITDA 80,000,000 the capacity is 25,000,000 (floor wins); with 200,000,000 it is 50,000,000; with no approved EBITDA the metric branch is unknown, so no figure above the floor may be reported.

verdicts.check: EBITDA 80m → 25,000,000 (floor > 20m)
no approved EBITDA → NEEDS_INPUT, or at most the 25,000,000 floor (never more)
verdicts.detail: NEEDS_INPUT, remaining NOT_DETERMINED(a financial fact this capacity depends on is missing)
